cipher.name: ReverseWordCipher
cipher.idea: Each individual word in the text is reversed, while the original order of the words, spaces, and punctuation marks remains exactly the same. This is highly intuitive for language models to process and reverse, ensuring high semantic coherence while breaking standard token sequences.
cipher.encrypt_rules: 1. Split the input text into a sequence of words and non-word characters (spaces, punctuation). 2. For each sequence of consecutive alphabetic characters (a-z, A-Z), reverse the order of the characters. 3. Keep all non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, numbers) in their original positions.
cipher.decrypt_rules: 1. Split the input text into a sequence of words and non-word characters (spaces, punctuation). 2. For each sequence of consecutive alphabetic characters (a-z, A-Z), reverse the order of the characters. 3. Keep all non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, numbers) in their original positions.

example.plaintext: Hello World! This is a test.
example.ciphertext: olleH dlroW! sihT si a tset.
